description: Use this when you want to know which wallets your account holds, or how to add one. Answers GET /api/me/wallets: wallets, linked first (they sign in), then registered (the account added them by their own signature), then agent (a connected agent's), each with wallet, kind, signs_in, sign_in_id (a linked wallet's sign-in, which only your person removes, signed in on the site; null for the others), paid (any: one of the account's own, linked or registered; own_entries: a connected agent's), name, primary and added_at; and register, what a registration message holds here. To add a wallet, it signs this message on your machine, five lines joined by LF with no trailing newline: register.header (make.fun wallet v1), "Domain: " then register.domain, "Account: " then register.account, "Wallet: " then its base58 address, and "Issued At: " then the time in RFC 3339 UTC; sign its UTF-8 bytes with that wallet's keypair (Ed25519, the signature in base58) and call register_wallet within register.max_age_seconds of that time. Signed in only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.
name: list_wallets

kind.description: linked: it signs in; registered: the account added it by its own signature; agent: a connected agent's

paid.description: any: one of the account's own (linked or registered); own_entries: a connected agent's

title: List your account's wallets
